from datetime import datetime, timedelta

def get_access_token():
    creds=apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords(); pass_simple=[c['password'] for c in creds if c['account_name']=='simple_note'][0]
    return apis.simple_note.login(username='sab-brown@gmail.com', password=pass_simple)['access_token']

access_token=get_access_token()
now=datetime.now(); today=now.date(); yesterday=today-timedelta(days=1)

date_str_today=str(today); date_str_yesterday=str(yesterday)

# Fetch yesterday note
expected_title_yesterday=f'Habit Tracker Log for {date_str_yesterday}'
notes_y=[]
page_index=0; page_limit=20
while True:
    res=apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=access_token, query=date_str_yesterday, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not res:
        break
    notes_y.extend(res)
    page_index+=1

exact_y=[n for n in notes_y if n['title']==expected_title_yesterday]
if len(exact_y)!=1:
    raise Exception('Expected exactly 1 yesterday habit tracker note')

y=apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=exact_y[0]['note_id'], access_token=access_token)
content_y=y['content']

# Prepare today content by changing meditation yes->no
old_line='practiced_meditation: yes'
new_line='practiced_meditation: no'
if old_line not in content_y:
    raise Exception('Old meditation line not found in yesterday content')
content_today=content_y.replace(old_line,new_line)

expected_title_today=f'Habit Tracker Log for {date_str_today}'

# Ensure no existing today note
notes_t=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    res=apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=access_token, query=date_str_today, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not res:
        break
    notes_t.extend(res)
    page_index+=1

exact_today=[n for n in notes_t if n['title']==expected_title_today]
if exact_today:
    raise Exception('Today habit tracker note already exists; refusing to create duplicate')

payload={
    'title': expected_title_today,
    'content': content_today,
    'tags': y.get('tags',[]),
    'pinned': y.get('pinned',False)
}

print('Creating Simple Note with payload:')
print({k:(v if k!='content' else ('len='+str(len(v)))) for k,v in payload.items()})

create_res=apis.simple_note.create_note(access_token=access_token, title=payload['title'], content=payload['content'], tags=payload['tags'], pinned=payload['pinned'])
print('create_res',create_res)
new_note_id=create_res['note_id']

# Verify created note
created=apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=new_note_id, access_token=access_token)
print('created title',created['title'],'note_id',created['note_id'],'pinned',created.get('pinned'),'tags',created.get('tags'))
print('meditation line:', [l for l in created['content'].splitlines() if 'practiced_meditation:' in l])
print('old meditation still present?', old_line in created['content'])
print('new meditation present?', new_line in created['content'])
